newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Stockpile of S.Korean steel goods at record level.
newsitem.headline: Stockpile of S.Korean steel goods at record level.

text.p: Inventories of South Korean steel products reached a historical high of 2.15 million tonnes at the end of July, an official at the Korea Iron and Steel Association said on Thursday.
This compared with 1.55 million tonnes a year earlier.
"Production capacity of reinforcing bars and H-beams in particular has increased, while demand is lacklustre," said an analyst at Daewoo Securities.
The association figures showed the reinforcing bar stockpile was at its record high of 662,000 tonnes at the end of July against 97,000 tonnes a year ago.
The association said South Korea's annual reinforcing bar output rose by one million tonnes to 10 million this year from a year ago.

South Korean steel companies have aggressively expanded product capacity since the late 1980s in line with a boom in the domestic construction sector, after the government initiated the construction of two million apartment units.
The Daewoo analyst attributed the recently rising inventory to a slump in the domestic home building industry.
"This increase in the stockpile is not likely to ease soon," said the association official. -- Seoul Newsroom (822) 727 5647
